integrity: The exact face poset, full discrete Morse certificate, signed primitive cocycle, signed cycle and integral Alexander-Whitney cup calculation have a standalone stdlib verifier.
scientific_limitations: Only the six-vertex bidirected cycle; no equivariant or uniform family statement. Integral zero-cup-square and an acyclic matching prove the stated nonequivariant homotopy equivalence. Previously computed homology alone was insufficient. Independent scientific validation has not been performed. Equivalent unindexed work remains possible.
title: A vanishing Hopf obstruction for the bidirected hexagon multipath complex
